posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked:
In Media Res is going to be an absolute nightmare when combined with Vengeance La Capitan's Throwback and A Stitch In Time.  It'll be interesting to see whether people prefer to put Stuntman first in the round so as to give all the heroes their turns after using it, or later so as to skip the expiration of cards that expire on a hero's turn.

Moving Target might just be my favorite new card.  If damage gets redirected away from Stuntman for any reason, or prevented or reduced to zero, he gets a free power use.  Combine with Stealth Bot, Lead from the Front, Human Shield, or Void Guard Mainstay's Leader of the Pack, or alternatively Energy Bracer, Counterpoint Bulwark, and his own Stylish Armour, for stupid numbers of power uses round after round (not even counting all the cards that grant a round of damage redirection or prevention).
